result.rationale: The diff in packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts changes `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, which inverts the condition: previously slug was written when team billing was disabled; now it is only written when enabled. The mechanism described matches the diff exactly — self-hosted (billing disabled) orgs would no longer get a slug. This is a real behavioral regression, though downstream consequences are inferred.

judged_text: The spread condition was inverted: `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` became `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, flipping which billing mode sets slug and which sets metadata.requestedSlug. With team billing disabled (self-hosted default), organization creation no longer sets `slug` at all — organizations are created without a URL slug and existing flows that read org slug break; with billing enabled, slug is now written directly AND requestedSlug in metadata, contradicting the billing flow that previously only recorded requestedSlug pending payment.
